{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Get array with all items (of any kind, even weapons) from vest.

|s1= [[vestItems]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s - Class names of items

|x1= <sqf>

</sqf>
